## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Summary

Default dispatch between FROST and the cuDNN backend is a growing set of hand-written measured boxes in `sdpa/fwd/placement.py` and `sdpa/bwd/heuristics.py`. Each box covers the points one study measured. Outside every box the backend leads, whatever the real ratio. This PR adds the infrastructure to grow placement from data instead:

- **`cudnn/sdpa/placement_table.py`:** a measured table consulted first by `place()` and `_leads()`.
  - A class is read off the graph facts: row, part, dtype, head pair, phase (q = 1 / 2–4 / prefill), layout (dense / paged / THD / ragged THD), mask, sink, MHA vs GQA, and whether S_kv is off the 128-key tile.
  - Each entry is one monotone rule on a single scalar, the roofline-shaped cost proxy `log2(max(FLOPs / 16, bytes))` or the parallel-tile count, whichever the class's data is monotone in: `always`, `never`, `ge T` or `le T`.
  - Graphs with a feature no study measured (fp8, bias, dropout, score mods, deterministic, bounded declarations, …) and classes without an entry fall through to the existing rules unchanged.
- **`benchmark/placement_gen/gen.py`:** fits a frozen study (train JSONL + holdout JSONL from the existing study drivers) into entries.
  - Every case is converted to graph facts and classified with the runtime's own `class_key`, so a fitted class is the class a graph looks up.
  - The threshold sits halfway, in log2 work, between the last training loss and the first win past it, in whichever direction keeps more wins. Cells within a 3% margin of parity never move it.
  - It prints generated / measured-default / backend-only regret on train and holdout; a case whose class has no entry is scored by the measured default leg, which is what the runtime runs there.
  - It **refuses to emit a class whose wins and losses interleave** (NON-MONOTONE). The answer to such a class is a finer key, not a box around its points.
- **First conversion:** on cc 10.0 with exact declarations, SM100 paged bf16 D576x512 MLA decode (#1933) is now answered by two generated entries of the same study (MTP: `always`; s_q = 1: a cost threshold), on and off the tile. The #1933 hand floor stays as the fallback for graphs the study did not measure (other SM100-row parts, bounded declarations), so behaviour there is unchanged.
- **Rule S12** (`python/cudnn/sdpa/AGENTS.md`): new FROST-vs-backend boundaries start as a study, `TABLE` is never hand-edited, and a non-monotone class gets a finer key.

## Why

Generating the rules from data scales with kernels and parts. On the two B200 studies where hand-written rules exist, the generator reproduces them from the data alone. Regret is chosen ÷ faster leg, geo / max.

| Study | Holdout, generated | Holdout, hand rule | Train, generated | Train, hand rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D576 MLA decode (#1933) | 1.000 / 1.000 | 1.000 / 1.000 | 1.003 / 1.383 | same |
| d256 / D192x128 backward (#1944) | 1.001 / 1.028 | 1.001 / 1.028 | 1.000 / 1.012 | 1.001 / 1.053 |

Backend-only regret on the D576 holdout is 70.2 / 310. On the backward study the generator also found, without being told, the reverse-direction corner (mask-free ragged THD leads only *below* a work threshold) that #1944 hand-writes. The backward entries will land after #1944 merges.

## Related issues

Follows #1933 (D576 decode placement) and #1944 (d256 backward default). It is the first step of replacing hand-drawn placement regions with measured, generated ones.

### What the data taught the generator (in this PR)

- **The cost scalar.** A FLOPs-only scalar (`h_q·b·s_q·s_kv`) fit the D576 and backward studies but not SM100 d256 decode. There the FROST/backend ratio follows KV bytes and does not depend on h_q, so 19 of 200 training cells stayed misranked. `log2(max(FLOPs / 16, bytes))` fits all three B200 studies with one threshold per class:

  | Study | Train regret (geo / max) |
  |---|---|
  | D576 decode | 1.003 / 1.383 |
  | Backward | 1.000 / 1.012 |
  | d256 decode | 1.001 / 1.109, vs the hand rules' 1.019 / 1.691 |

  Balances 8, 32 and the part's ~280 each lose one study.
- **Blocked split-KV.** The d256 decode holdout drew S_kv off the 128-key tile in all 40 cases. Two cases ran 11–13× slower on FROST: off the tile it cannot split KV, and the aligned grid never saw that. `S_kv % 128 != 0` is now part of the class for every layout, so an on-tile study never answers for an off-tile graph. Paged KV can split off the tile, but it still measures differently there: off-tile paged d256 decode wins at lower cost than on-tile (0.88–0.90 vs 1.02–1.11 at the same cost). Every on-tile class has a measured off-tile twin, including D576, so no off-tile graph falls back to the backend for lack of data (review: an off-tile paged D576 decode had lost its FROST route).
- **A second feature.** Off the tile, dense d256 decode follows the grid's **parallel tiles** (b·h_kv), not the cost. FROST runs 1.3–15× slower below 32 tiles and faster from 64, at any S_kv. So the generator now fits each class on every scalar in `FEATURES` (`cost`, `tiles`), keeps the one with the lowest training regret, and records it in the entry. It picked `tiles` for that class and `cost` everywhere else; the D576 and backward studies are unchanged.
- **Entries (two studies, full-power B200, cuDNN 9.28.0.38).**
  - `sm100_d256_decode_v3_20261028`: 200 on-tile + 200 off-tile cells (h_q / h_kv 4/1 – 32/2, b 1–128, S_kv 2k–128k, dense and paged), plus 48 dense off-tile cells at 34–60 parallel tiles. Those fill a gap the v2 grid left between 32 and 64 tiles, where review found a regressed point (B40 h_q 4 S_kv 2049: FROST 0.68× of the backend on 9.28, 0.64× on 9.26). Training regret 1.001 / 1.132 (3 of 448 > 1.05); the hand rules give 1.017 / 1.691.
  - `sm100_d576_decode_v2_20261028`: the #1933 128-case grid on the tile plus the same grid off it. Training regret 1.001 / 1.383 (1 of 256).
- **Qualification.** Each refit was checked on holdouts frozen (sha256) before the fit and run once at the frozen head, with the parents' choices taken from their own default dispatch on the same graphs. Regret is geo / max / count > 1.05.
  - Earlier holdouts at earlier heads: holdout1 found the off-tile class, holdout2 (40 cases) 1.007 / 1.320 vs the hand rules' 1.182 / 7.495, holdout3 (40 paged) 1.003 / 1.171.
  - **Final, at `ad26bc45b`:** holdout4 (40 dense off-tile d256 cases, 20–100 tiles) and holdout5 (20 paged d256 near the cost boundary + 20 paged D576, q 1–4, half off the tile). No co-tenant on the GPU during the timed legs.

    | Rule | holdout4 | holdout5 d256 | holdout5 D576 | all 80 |
    |---|---|---|---|---|
    | develop | 1.003 / 1.045 / 0 | 1.079 / 1.747 / 4 | 1.000 / 1.000 / 0 | 1.021 / 1.747 / 4 |
    | previous head `8c11ce2de` | 1.087 / 1.823 / 6 | 1.000 / 1.000 / 0 | 1.000 / 1.000 / 0 | 1.043 / 1.823 / 6 |
    | this head | 1.002 / 1.032 / 0 | 1.000 / 1.009 / 0 | 0.999 / 1.005 / 0 | 1.001 / 1.032 / 0 |

  - Versus develop, 6 routes change. Four are paged d256 at b·h_kv ≤ 3, now FROST at 1.16–1.75×. Two are dense at 32 tiles, now backend at 0.96–0.98× of develop's FROST. None is slower.
  - Holdout4 against the cuDNN 9.26 backend (FROST timing does not depend on it): this head 1.002 / 1.050 / 0, develop 1.000 / 1.012 / 0, `8c11ce2de` 1.104 / 1.958 / 8.

## API and compatibility impact

None to the API. Placement changes only where the table has an entry: on cc 10.0 with exact declarations and no window or sink, SM100 paged bf16 D576x512 decode and SM100 bf16 d256 s_q == 1 decode (dense and paged), each on and off the 128-key tile.
- **MTP** keeps LEAD.
- **s_q == 1** leads when the cost proxy crosses the generated threshold. This includes points outside the training grid's ranges, which the threshold extrapolates to. Example: h_q 4 at b 1, S_kv 49152 now leads where #1933's `h_q·b·S_kv ≥ 2^20` floor trailed. A reviewer native spot check found that point faster on FROST.
- **Everything else is unchanged:** other parts, bounded declarations, dense D576, f16, window, sink. Those keep the #1933 floor or the existing rules.

## Testing

- New `test/python/sdpa/frost/test_placement_table.py`:
  - entries are well-formed and name known rows;
  - the class key ignores causal at s_q = 1;
  - unmeasured features never reach the table;
  - thresholds split on log2 work;
  - another part (cc 10.3) has no entry.
- `test_paged_d576_mla_decode_leads_past_its_work_floor` now checks the full training grid against the generated entry, plus the dense / f16 / window / sink / 2^19 / MTP controls.
- `pytest -m "" sdpa/frost/test_placement_table.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_placement.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bwd_heuristics.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_heuristics.py core`: 1068 passed. The one failure, `core/graph/test_kernel_cache.py::test_serialize_both_graph_and_kernel_cache`, fails identically on clean develop on this host.

+# Placement table generator
+
+`gen.py` turns a frozen FROST-vs-backend sweep into entries of `python/cudnn/sdpa/placement_table.py`, the measured table that `fwd/placement.place` and `bwd/heuristics._leads` consult before their hand-written rules (Rule S12 in `python/cudnn/sdpa/AGENTS.md`).
+
+## Workflow
+
+1. **Freeze a study.** Write the training grid and a seeded random holdout, record their sha256, and only then time anything. A study JSON names:
+   - `id`, `row` (the FROST engine spec name), `device_cc`, `dtype` (`bf16` / `f16`);
+   - `adapter`: `inference` for the generation phase of `benchmark/attention_inference`, or `training` for `benchmark/attention_training`;
+   - head pair defaults (`d_qk`, `d_v`), an optional `layout` default;
+   - the `train` / `holdout` JSONL paths.
+2. **Sweep on the target part.** Run the `cudnn` (backend only), `cudnn_oss` (FROST first) and `cudnn_auto` (default dispatch) legs. Write one JSON line per (case, leg) with `ms`, `plan` and the `case` dict. Use a full-power board, and record co-tenant GPU processes at start and end.
+3. **Fit:** `python benchmark/placement_gen/gen.py study.json`. Every case becomes graph facts, classified with `placement_table.class_key`, the same code the runtime uses. Per class, every scalar in `placement_table.FEATURES` is fit (today: `cost`, the roofline proxy, and `tiles`, the parallel tiles before a KV split). Each fit is:
+   - `always`;
+   - `never`;
+   - or one threshold halfway between the last training loss and the first win past it, in the direction that keeps more wins.
+
+   The feature with the lowest training regret is kept and recorded in the entry. Cells within `--margin` of parity (default 3%) never move a threshold. A class that no feature can split monotonically is **NON-MONOTONE** and gets no entry; refine the class key instead.
+4. **Qualify on the frozen holdout, once, at the frozen head.** The holdout must exercise every class the entries cover (on- and off-tile S_kv, every layout), was never used to fit or to choose a feature or constant, and is consumed by the run.
+5. **Score.** The tool prints generated vs measured-default vs backend-only regret on train and holdout. The holdout must show no case where the generated choice is slower than the measured default beyond noise.
+6. **Emit:** `gen.py study.json --emit` prints the entries. Paste them as one block under a comment naming the study, part, cuDNN version and case counts.
+
+Entries carry the study id. Re-run the study when a kernel change touches the row's capabilities.

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Fit placement-table entries from a frozen study and score them on its holdout.
+
+    python benchmark/placement_gen/gen.py <study.json> [--emit]
+
+A study JSON names the row, device, dtype, harness adapter, head pair and the train / holdout JSONL files written by the
+study drivers (one record per (case, leg) with ``ms``, ``plan``, ``case``). Each case is turned into graph facts and
+classified with ``cudnn.sdpa.placement_table.class_key`` -- the same code the runtime uses -- so a fitted class is
+exactly the class a graph looks up.
+
+Per class, every scalar in ``placement_table.FEATURES`` is fit monotonically: ``always`` (FROST never loses beyond the
+margin), ``never`` (it never wins), or a threshold halfway between the last training loss and the first win past it, in
+the direction that keeps more wins. The feature with the lowest training regret is kept and recorded in the entry; the
+frozen holdout, run once at the frozen head, remains the independent qualification. A class whose
+wins and losses interleave so that neither direction keeps a win is reported as NON-MONOTONE and gets no entry: split
+the class (add a key field) rather than fitting around it.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import collections
+import json
+import math
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import cudnn
+from cudnn.sdpa import placement_table as pt
+
+_DTYPES = {"bf16": cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, "f16": cudnn.data_type.HALF}
+
+
+def _facts_inference(c, s):
+    """Inference harness (generation phase): q tokens per request, dense or paged KV (case field, else the study default)."""
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        b=c["b"],
+        h_q=c["hq"],
+        h_kv=c.get("hkv", 1),
+        s_q=c["q"],
+        s_kv=c["kv"],
+        d_qk=s["d_qk"],
+        d_v=s["d_v"],
+        dtype=_DTYPES[s["dtype"]],
+        causal=True,
+        bottom_right=True,
+        window_left=c.get("window"),
+        has_sink=bool(c.get("sink")),
+        has_paged_kv=c.get("layout", s.get("layout", "dense")) == "paged",
+        thd=False,
+        max_total_seq_len_q=None,
+        device_cc=tuple(s["device_cc"]),
+        has_bias=False,
+        has_dropout=False,
+        right_band_widening=False,
+    )
+
+
+def _facts_training(c, s):
+    """Training harness: s_q == s_kv == s; THD at fill < 1 declares its live total (ragged)."""
+    thd = c["layout"] == "thd"
+    total = c["b"] * c["s"] if c.get("fill", 1.0) >= 1.0 else int(c["b"] * c["s"] * (1 + c["fill"]) / 2)
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        b=c["b"],
+        h_q=c["hq"],
+        h_kv=c["hkv"],
+        s_q=c["s"],
+        s_kv=c["s"],
+        d_qk=c.get("d_qk", s.get("d_qk")),
+        d_v=c.get("d_v", s.get("d_v")),
+        dtype=_DTYPES[s["dtype"]],
+        causal=c["mask"] != "no_mask",
+        bottom_right=False,
+        window_left=c.get("window"),
+        has_sink=False,
+        has_paged_kv=False,
+        thd=thd,
+        max_total_seq_len_q=total if thd else None,
+        device_cc=tuple(s["device_cc"]),
+        has_bias=False,
+        has_dropout=False,
+        right_band_widening=False,
+    )
+
+
+ADAPTERS = {"inference": _facts_inference, "training": _facts_training}
+
+
+def load(path):
+    rows = collections.defaultdict(dict)
+    for line in open(path):
+        r = json.loads(line)
+        if r.get("ms") is not None:
+            rows[r["idx"]][r["leg"]] = r
+    return [d for d in rows.values() if "cudnn" in d and "cudnn_oss" in d]
+
+
+def fit(points, margin):
+    """points: [(log2_work, frost/backend ratio)] of one class -> (direction, threshold) or ("non-monotone", None)."""
+    wins = [w for w, r in points if r < 1 - margin]
+    losses = [w for w, r in points if r > 1 + margin]
+    if not wins:
+        return "never", None
+    if not losses:
+        return "always", None
+    top, bottom = max(losses), min(losses)
+    above, below = [w for w in wins if w > top], [w for w in wins if w < bottom]
+    if not above and not below:
+        return "non-monotone", None
+    # The threshold sits halfway (in log2 work) between the last loss and the first win past it, rounded away from the
+    # loss so the emitted value never re-admits it.
+    if len(above) >= len(below):
+        return "ge", math.ceil((top + min(above)) / 2 * 1000) / 1000
+    return "le", math.floor((bottom + max(below)) / 2 * 1000) / 1000
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("study")
+    ap.add_argument("--margin", type=float, default=0.03, help="|ratio - 1| within this is neutral")
+    ap.add_argument("--emit", action="store_true", help="print the TABLE block for cudnn/sdpa/placement_table.py")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    s = json.load(open(args.study))
+    to_facts = ADAPTERS[s["adapter"]]
+    train, hold = load(s["train"]), load(s["holdout"])
+
+    by = collections.defaultdict(list)
+    for d in train:
+        f = to_facts(d["cudnn"]["case"], s)
+        key = pt.class_key(s["row"], f)
+        if key is not None:
+            by[key].append((f, d["cudnn_oss"]["ms"] / d["cudnn"]["ms"], d["cudnn"]["ms"], d["cudnn_oss"]["ms"]))
+
+    def class_regret(pts, feat, rule):
+        direction, t = rule
+        out = []
+        for f, _, b, fr in pts:
+            lead = direction == "always" or (direction == "ge" and pt.FEATURES[feat](f) >= t) or (direction == "le" and pt.FEATURES[feat](f) <= t)
+            out.append((fr if lead else b) / min(b, fr))
+        return sum(map(math.log, out)) / len(out), max(out)
+
+    # Per class, fit every feature and keep the one with the lowest training regret (geo, then max); "cost" wins ties.
+    table, feature_of = {}, {}
+    for k, pts in by.items():
+        best = None
+        for feat in pt.FEATURES:
+            rule = fit([(pt.FEATURES[feat](f), r) for f, r, _, _ in pts], args.margin)
+            if rule[0] == "non-monotone":
+                continue
+            score = class_regret(pts, feat, rule)
+            if best is None or score < best[0]:
+                best = (score, feat, rule)
+        table[k] = best[2] if best else ("non-monotone", None)
+        feature_of[k] = best[1] if best else "cost"
+
+    def pick(case):
+        """True / False for a class with an entry; None where the runtime falls back to the hand-written rules."""
+        f = to_facts(case, s)
+        key = pt.class_key(s["row"], f)
+        direction, t = table.get(key, (None, None))
+        if direction in (None, "non-monotone"):
+            return None
+        if direction in ("never", "always"):
+            return direction == "always"
+        w = pt.FEATURES[feature_of[key]](f)
+        return w >= t if direction == "ge" else w <= t
+
+    g = lambda xs: math.exp(sum(map(math.log, xs)) / len(xs))
+    print(f"study {s['id']}: {len(train)} train / {len(hold)} holdout cases, {len(table)} classes")
+    for k, (direction, t) in sorted(table.items(), key=lambda kv: str(kv[0])):
+        n = len(by[k])
+        print(f"  {k[3:]}  n={n:3d}  {direction}" + ("" if t is None else f" {t:.2f} on {feature_of[k]}"))
+    # A case whose class has no entry is scored by what the runtime does there -- the hand-written fallback, i.e. the
+    # measured default leg (``cudnn_auto``); without that leg it is left unscored and counted.
+    for label, rows in (("train", train), ("holdout", hold)):
+        for rule, chooser in (("generated", lambda d: pick(d["cudnn"]["case"])), ("measured default", None), ("backend only", lambda d: False)):
+            regs, unscored = [], 0
+            for d in rows:
+                b, f = d["cudnn"]["ms"], d["cudnn_oss"]["ms"]
+                choice = None if chooser is None else chooser(d)
+                if choice is None:
+                    if "cudnn_auto" not in d:
+                        unscored += 1
+                        continue
+                    regs.append(d["cudnn_auto"]["ms"] / min(b, f))
+                else:
+                    regs.append((f if choice else b) / min(b, f))
+            why = "no measured default leg" if chooser is None else "no entry and no measured default leg"
+            extra = f"  ({unscored} unscored: {why})" if unscored else ""
+            if regs:
+                print(f"  {label:8s} {rule:16s} regret geo {g(regs):.3f} max {max(regs):.3f} >1.05 {sum(r > 1.05 for r in regs)}/{len(regs)}{extra}")
+            elif rows:
+                print(f"  {label:8s} {rule:16s} NOT SCORED: 0/{len(rows)} cases{extra}")
+    bad = [k for k, (direction, _) in table.items() if direction == "non-monotone"]
+    if bad:
+        print("NON-MONOTONE classes (split the key; no entry emitted):", *bad, sep="\n  ")
+    if args.emit:
+        print(f"\n    # study {s['id']}")
+        for k, (direction, t) in sorted(table.items(), key=lambda kv: str(kv[0])):
+            if direction != "non-monotone":
+                feat = "" if t is None or feature_of[k] == "cost" else f", {feature_of[k]!r}"
+                print(f"    {k!r}: Entry({direction!r}, {t!r}, {s['id']!r}{feat}),")
+    return 1 if bad else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Measured placement table: FROST row vs the backend, per shape class, generated from frozen sweeps.
+
+A class is read off the graph facts (row, device, dtype, head pair, phase, layout, mask, sink, MHA vs GQA, and whether
+S_kv is off the 128-key tile). Each entry
+is a monotone rule on ONE scalar from :data:`FEATURES` -- the roofline-shaped cost proxy :func:`log2_work` or the
+parallel-tile count :func:`log2_tiles`, whichever the class's data is monotone in: ``always``, ``never``, ``ge T`` (FROST leads
+from T up) or ``le T`` (FROST leads up to T). Entries are produced by ``benchmark/placement_gen`` from a training grid
+and qualified on a frozen holdout; every entry names its study. Do not edit entries by hand -- regenerate.
+
+:func:`lookup` answers ``True`` (lead), ``False`` (trail) or ``None`` (no entry, or a feature no study measured); the
+hand-written rules in ``sdpa/fwd/placement.py`` / ``sdpa/bwd/heuristics.py`` decide every ``None``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from typing import Dict, NamedTuple, Optional, Tuple
+
+import cudnn
+
+
+class Entry(NamedTuple):
+    direction: str  # "always" | "never" | "ge" | "le"
+    log2_work: Optional[float]  # the threshold for "ge" / "le", in the entry's feature
+    study: str  # the frozen study that produced it (grid + holdout hashes live in its record)
+    feature: str = "cost"  # which scalar the threshold reads: a key of FEATURES
+
+
+def _dtype_name(dtype) -> Optional[str]:
+    if dtype == cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16:
+        return "bf16"
+    if dtype == cudnn.data_type.HALF:
+        return "f16"
+    return None
+
+
+def _unmeasured(facts) -> bool:
+    """Features no study sweeps: such a graph keeps the hand-written rules."""
+    return bool(
+        getattr(facts, "is_fp8", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "is_mxfp8", False)
+        or facts.has_bias
+        or facts.has_dropout
+        or getattr(facts, "has_score_mod", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "has_alibi", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "has_block_mask", False)
+        or facts.right_band_widening
+        or getattr(facts, "deterministic", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "has_dbias", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "o_block_scale", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "shape_overrides", False)
+    )
+
+
+def class_key(row: str, facts) -> Optional[Tuple]:
+    dtype = _dtype_name(facts.dtype)
+    if dtype is None or _unmeasured(facts) or not facts.h_kv or facts.h_q % facts.h_kv:
+        return None
+    if facts.s_q == 1:
+        phase = "q1"
+    elif facts.s_q <= 4:
+        phase = "mtp"
+    else:
+        phase = "prefill"
+    if facts.has_paged_kv:
+        layout = "paged"
+    elif facts.thd:
+        total = facts.max_total_seq_len_q
+        layout = "thd_ragged" if total is not None and total < facts.b * facts.s_q else "thd"
+    else:
+        layout = "dense"
+    if facts.window_left is not None:
+        mask = "window"
+    elif facts.causal and not (facts.s_q == 1 and facts.bottom_right):  # one bottom-right row sees every key: no mask
+        mask = "causal_br" if facts.bottom_right else "causal_tl"
+    else:
+        mask = "none"
+    group = "mha" if facts.h_q == facts.h_kv else "gqa"
+    # Off the 128-key tile dense KV cannot split and paged KV measures differently near the boundary: its own class, which
+    # an on-tile study never answers.
+    kv_off_tile = facts.s_kv % 128 != 0
+    return (row, tuple(facts.device_cc or ()), dtype, (facts.d_qk, facts.d_v), phase, layout, mask, bool(facts.has_sink), group, kv_off_tile)
+
+
+COST_BALANCE = 16.0
+"""FLOPs per byte at which the cost proxy switches from bytes to FLOPs. Chosen from the data, not the part's peak: with
+16, one threshold per class fits the three B200 studies at once (prefill-shaped backward is FLOP-bound, d256 decode is
+KV-byte-bound and independent of h_q, D576 MLA decode with up to 128 query heads is FLOP-bound); 8, 32 and the
+part's ~280 each lose one of them."""
+
+
+def log2_work(facts) -> float:
+    """log2 of a roofline-shaped cost proxy, max(FLOPs / COST_BALANCE, bytes), for bf16 / f16 Q, K, V, O."""
+    width = facts.d_qk + facts.d_v
+    flops = 2.0 * facts.b * facts.h_q * facts.s_q * facts.s_kv * width
+    nbytes = 2.0 * facts.b * (facts.h_kv * facts.s_kv + facts.h_q * facts.s_q) * width
+    return math.log2(max(1.0, flops / COST_BALANCE, nbytes))
+
+
+def log2_tiles(facts) -> float:
+    """log2 of the grid's parallel tiles before any KV split: b * h_kv * ceil(s_q * G / 128) (packed Q rows per KV head)."""
+    group = max(1, facts.h_q // max(1, facts.h_kv))
+    return math.log2(max(1, facts.b * facts.h_kv * -(-facts.s_q * group // 128)))
+
+
+FEATURES = {"cost": log2_work, "tiles": log2_tiles}
+"""The scalars a class may be thresholded on; the generator picks, per class, the one its data is monotone in."""
+
+
+def lookup(row: str, facts) -> Optional[bool]:
+    key = class_key(row, facts)
+    entry = TABLE.get(key) if key is not None else None
+    if entry is None:
+        return None
+    if entry.direction in ("always", "never"):
+        return entry.direction == "always"
+    w = FEATURES[entry.feature](facts)
+    return w >= entry.log2_work if entry.direction == "ge" else w <= entry.log2_work
+
+

+    ("sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100", (10, 0), "bf16", (256, 256), "q1", "dense", "none", False, "gqa", True): Entry(

+    ),

+    ("sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100", (10, 0), "bf16", (256, 256), "q1", "paged", "none", False, "gqa", True): Entry("ge", 24.532, "sm100_d256_decode_v3_20261028"),
+    # study sm100_d576_decode_v2_20261028 (full-power B200, cuDNN 9.28.0.38; frozen 128-case grid on the tile + the same grid off it)
+    ("sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100", (10, 0), "bf16", (576, 512), "mtp", "paged", "causal_br", False, "gqa", False): Entry(
+        "always", None, "sm100_d576_decode_v2_20261028"
+    ),
+    ("sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100", (10, 0), "bf16", (576, 512), "mtp", "paged", "causal_br", False, "gqa", True): Entry(
+        "always", None, "sm100_d576_decode_v2_20261028"
+    ),
+    ("sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100", (10, 0), "bf16", (576, 512), "q1", "paged", "none", False, "gqa", False): Entry("ge", 26.588, "sm100_d576_decode_v2_20261028"),
+    ("sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100", (10, 0), "bf16", (576, 512), "q1", "paged", "none", False, "gqa", True): Entry("ge", 26.131, "sm100_d576_decode_v2_20261028"),

+        direction, t = table.get(key, ("never", None))

+            return direction == "always"
+        w = pt.log2_work(f)
+        return w >= t if direction == "ge" else w <= t

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Measured placement table: FROST row vs the backend, per shape class, generated from frozen sweeps.
+
+A class is read off the graph facts (row, device, dtype, head pair, phase, layout, mask, sink, MHA vs GQA, S_kv on
+the 128-key tile). Each entry
+is a monotone rule on ONE work scalar, :func:`log2_work` (a roofline-shaped cost proxy): ``always``, ``never``, ``ge T`` (FROST leads
+from T up) or ``le T`` (FROST leads up to T). Entries are produced by ``benchmark/placement_gen`` from a training grid
+and qualified on a frozen holdout; every entry names its study. Do not edit entries by hand -- regenerate.
+
+:func:`lookup` answers ``True`` (lead), ``False`` (trail) or ``None`` (no entry, or a feature no study measured); the
+hand-written rules in ``sdpa/fwd/placement.py`` / ``sdpa/bwd/heuristics.py`` decide every ``None``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from typing import Dict, NamedTuple, Optional, Tuple
+
+import cudnn
+
+
+class Entry(NamedTuple):
+    direction: str  # "always" | "never" | "ge" | "le"
+    log2_work: Optional[float]  # the threshold for "ge" / "le"
+    study: str  # the frozen study that produced it (grid + holdout hashes live in its record)
+
+
+def _dtype_name(dtype) -> Optional[str]:
+    if dtype == cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16:
+        return "bf16"
+    if dtype == cudnn.data_type.HALF:
+        return "f16"
+    return None
+
+
+def _unmeasured(facts) -> bool:
+    """Features no study sweeps: such a graph keeps the hand-written rules."""
+    return bool(
+        getattr(facts, "is_fp8", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "is_mxfp8", False)
+        or facts.has_bias
+        or facts.has_dropout
+        or getattr(facts, "has_score_mod", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "has_alibi", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "has_block_mask", False)
+        or facts.right_band_widening
+        or getattr(facts, "deterministic", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "has_dbias", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "o_block_scale", False)
+        or getattr(facts, "shape_overrides", False)
+    )
+
+
+def class_key(row: str, facts) -> Optional[Tuple]:
+    dtype = _dtype_name(facts.dtype)
+    if dtype is None or _unmeasured(facts) or not facts.h_kv or facts.h_q % facts.h_kv:
+        return None
+    if facts.s_q == 1:
+        phase = "q1"
+    elif facts.s_q <= 4:
+        phase = "mtp"
+    else:
+        phase = "prefill"
+    if facts.has_paged_kv:
+        layout = "paged"
+    elif facts.thd:
+        total = facts.max_total_seq_len_q
+        layout = "thd_ragged" if total is not None and total < facts.b * facts.s_q else "thd"
+    else:
+        layout = "dense"
+    if facts.window_left is not None:
+        mask = "window"
+    elif facts.causal and facts.s_q > 1:  # one query row: causal masks nothing
+        mask = "causal_br" if facts.bottom_right else "causal_tl"
+    else:
+        mask = "none"
+    group = "mha" if facts.h_q == facts.h_kv else "gqa"
+    # S_kv off the 128-key tile changes what the kernels can do (no split-KV), not just how long they run: its own class.
+    kv_aligned = facts.s_kv % 128 == 0
+    return (row, tuple(facts.device_cc or ()), dtype, (facts.d_qk, facts.d_v), phase, layout, mask, bool(facts.has_sink), group, kv_aligned)
+
+
+COST_BALANCE = 16.0
+"""FLOPs per byte at which the cost proxy switches from bytes to FLOPs. Chosen from the data, not the part's peak: with
+16, one threshold per class fits the three B200 studies at once (prefill-shaped backward is FLOP-bound, d256 decode is
+KV-byte-bound and independent of h_q, D576 MLA decode with up to 128 query heads is FLOP-bound); 8, 32 and the
+part's ~280 each lose one of them."""
+
+
+def log2_work(facts) -> float:
+    """log2 of a roofline-shaped cost proxy, max(FLOPs / COST_BALANCE, bytes), for bf16 / f16 Q, K, V, O."""
+    width = facts.d_qk + facts.d_v
+    flops = 2.0 * facts.b * facts.h_q * facts.s_q * facts.s_kv * width
+    nbytes = 2.0 * facts.b * (facts.h_kv * facts.s_kv + facts.h_q * facts.s_q) * width
+    return math.log2(max(1.0, flops / COST_BALANCE, nbytes))
+
+
+def lookup(row: str, facts) -> Optional[bool]:
+    key = class_key(row, facts)
+    entry = TABLE.get(key) if key is not None else None
+    if entry is None:
+        return None
+    if entry.direction in ("always", "never"):
+        return entry.direction == "always"
+    w = log2_work(facts)
+    return w >= entry.log2_work if entry.direction == "ge" else w <= entry.log2_work
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- generated
+# benchmark/placement_gen/gen.py --emit; one block per study, keys sorted. Do not edit by hand.
+TABLE: Dict[Tuple, Entry] = {
+    # study sm100_d576_decode_20261027 (full-power B200, cuDNN 9.28.0.38; frozen 128-case grid, 40-case holdout)
+    ("sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100", (10, 0), "bf16", (576, 512), "mtp", "paged", "causal_br", False, "gqa", True): Entry(

+    ),
